# TPC-Havoc Q14_v1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  100.00 * (
    SELECT
      SUM(l2.l_extendedprice * (
        1 - l2.l_discount
      ))
    FROM lineitem AS l2, part AS p2
    WHERE
      l2.l_partkey = p2.p_partkey
      AND p2.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%'
      AND l2.l_shipdate >= CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE)
      AND l2.l_shipdate < CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH'
  ) / (
    SELECT
      SUM(l3.l_extendedprice * (
        1 - l3.l_discount
      ))
    FROM lineitem AS l3, part AS p3
    WHERE
      l3.l_partkey = p3.p_partkey
      AND l3.l_shipdate >= CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE)
      AND l3.l_shipdate < CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH'
  ) AS promo_revenue
```
